metadata.title: Hypervelocity intracluster stars ejected by supermassive black hole binaries

notes: No eligible stars. At T:p1-b4, “the unbound star in the Milky Way halo” is mentioned only as a generic background example, without a catalog identifier or independent selection/analysis of that star. The anomalously fast Virgo ICPNe are discussed only as an unidentified group (T:p1-b8, T:p1-b9) and are not established as Galactic—i.e., Milky Way—unbound candidates. The simulated ejecta are particles rather than identifiable stars (T:p2-b10).
